_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL — no messaging/communications service contract is frozen (see lib/api-client/chat-store.ts and data/villa-admin-plan/report.md §9.6)
note: The recorded half of the durable chat store. Each thread folds onto one append-only journal at `.data/chat/<thread>.json` (CHAT_STORE_DIR), and every later message/state is a journal event — this file is never edited by the app.

WHAT THIS IS: app-authored demo conversations for the board's chat mockup, in the same provisional spirit as lib/fixtures/family/*.json and lib/fixtures/agent/workspace.json. The Santos thread reproduces the board's own example (a signed application + ID, the office's balance schedule, 'attachments kept'). The Cory Customer thread is the one the signed-in family account (customer@vm.demo, the household the family portal renders) can open and answer; the Alex Agent thread is the signed-in agent's. participant_id is the account's identity: the family account's user_id or the agent's workspace id (lib/fixtures/agent/workspace.json `agent.id`).

ATTACHMENTS: each attachment row carries the sha256 of bytes committed under lib/fixtures/chat/files/ (see that folder's manifest.json); lib/chat-attachment-store.ts copies each into .data/attachments on first read. tests/fixture-contract/chat.test.ts pins every hash to its file's bytes and every file to the allow-list.

NEVER INVENTED: no delivery state is asserted as live. States are the office's recorded read/delivered marks from a past session; the app appends only the states its own requests observe. No amount, no contract number and no case reference is fabricated.
The recorded instants are true UTC instants; every screen prints them in Asia/Manila through lib/agent/agent-view.ts (manilaDay/manilaTime).
